prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1085; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right entered and struck the side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt a sharp jolt through my neck and lower back. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave the same description of what happened to the officer, to the other driver, and later to the adjuster when I called in. I have held the policy on this vehicle for the full term and I was the listed driver at the time of the collision. Since the accident I have had stiffness in my neck and a dull ache in my lower back, which I am having checked by my doctor. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed with my account on record.
